facts.summary: Phase 3-like NIAID trial missed primary endpoint · Phase 2/3 platform trial · lenzilumab in hospitalized COVID-19 · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The trial did not achieve statistical significance on the primary endpoint, which was defined as the proportion of patients with baseline CRP<150 mg/L and age<85 years, alive and without mechanical ventilation through Day 29.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The trial did not achieve statistical significance on the primary endpoint, which was defined as the proportion of patients with baseline CRP<150 mg/L and age<85 years, alive and without mechanical ventilation through Day 29.
evidence.safety: There were no new safety signals attributed to lenzilumab in the ACTIV-5/BET-B study.
